constraints.database: fresh database per validator, booted once, then npm run seed; nothing else pre-loaded
constraints.accounts: scripts/create-test-member.mjs: member@test.local and the admin, platform and career terms accepted (--no-terms only for steps that test terms)
constraints.browser: the pinned Chromium named in the release-loop args; no other browser
constraints.fixtures: only the fixtures written in the spec and its appendices, created through the UI unless a precondition says otherwise
constraints.codeUnderTest: the integration-branch commit named in the report; the only variable between rounds
